_description: Sogepps builds mobile applications including HomeParty, Spinify, Roll or Dare (YerseYap), Shot Çarkı, Tahmin Meleği - İddaa, Metin2 Okey, Sessiz Kelime and SogeGammon online backgammon. Discover apps for party games, raffles, tournaments, wheel spinners and word games.
hero_title:
We build apps that
simplify your life
hero_desc: Sogepps creates intuitive mobile applications designed to solve real-world problems. Simple, reliable, and built with care.
about_desc: Sogepps is a software studio focused on mobile application development. We believe great software should be simple to use, reliable, and accessible to everyone. Our apps are designed with user experience as the top priority.
app_desc: Create leagues, knockout brackets, and round-robin tournaments in seconds. Track scores, view live standings, export results as PDF — all from your phone. Available on Android.
app_desc_homeparty: HomeParty is a fun app for anyone looking for games to play with friends at home. It helps you pick and start a game in seconds on party nights, family gatherings and friend meetups.
app_desc_quickraffle: All-in-one raffle and random pick app: name picker, number draw, wheel, lottery, team picker, dice, coin flip, card draw, list shuffler, bingo, yes/no, Secret Santa, bracket, Magic 8 Ball, password generator and more. Fast, fair, and fun.
app_desc_spinify: Advanced wheel spinner app: create custom wheels, set real probability weights, use 14 ready-made presets, nested wheels, elimination mode, and full spin customization. Food picks, party games, chores, workouts, and everyday decisions.
app_name_yerseyap: Roll or Dare: Party Board Game
app_desc_yerseyap: Roll the dice, do the dare! Hundreds of dares, Adventure Island, monsters, mini games and the Wheel of Fate. A party board game for 2–10 players on one phone, in 73 languages.
app_desc_shot: Spin the party wheel, get a dare by difficulty, complete it for points or take a shot. Weighted odds, live scoreboard — for 2–12 players.
app_desc_tahminmelegi: Think of a football match, rub the witch fate cauldron, and read a single prophecy on the parchment. Match result, over/under, BTTS and more — entertainment only.
app_desc_metin2okey: Metin2 Okey helper: track tiles, see remaining top combos, and practice on web. Download the mobile app or play the web version.
app_desc_sessizkelime: Two teams race to guess words without speaking. Swipe right for correct, left for wrong, down for pass. 20+ categories, timers and pass limits — party-ready.
app_desc_sogegammon: Chip-free online backgammon. No chips needed to sit at a table: live matches against real opponents, a free tournament every 3 hours, ranked leaderboard, friend invites, board and dice themes. Play on web and Android.
articles_desc: Guides around our apps: party game ideas, raffle and tournament setup, rules and tactics.
footer_desc: Building useful mobile applications. Simple, reliable, and privacy-focused.
app_desc_sessizsinema: Act out films without a word while your team guesses. 600 films in 11 genres, titles as released in your country, 75 languages.
app_desc_cadiyasor: Ask a question, rub the witch's cauldron and read your fate. A magical book of answers with a crystal ball, a daily omen and 75 languages.
app_desc_kalemuhafizlari: Arm your castle with towers, stop the enemy waves and defeat the bosses. 250 levels, 5 tower types, 4 heroes, 75 languages. A free tower defense game.
app_desc_fishingdiary: Cast nets from your cannon and catch 150+ species! 40 legendary weapons, 20 ocean zones, 200 depths, epic bosses and pets. Plays offline. A free fishing game for Android.
footer_privacy_fishingdiary: Fishing Diary: Ocean Legends – Privacy Policy
app_desc_neonkaleler: Train troops, run your mines and smash the enemy castle! 300 levels of neon war.
